components.content: THIS ENDORSEMENT CHANGES THE POLICY. PLEASE READ IT CAREFULLY.
This endorsement modifies insurance provided under the following:
Description of Covered "Autos" To Which This Clause Applies:
We will pay, as interest may appear, you and the loss payee named in the Schedule above for a "loss" to a covered "auto" shown in the schedule.
The insurance covers the interest of the loss payee unless the "loss" results from conversion, secretion or embezzlement on your part.
We may cancel the policy as allowed by the CANCELLATION Common Policy Condition. Cancellation ends this agreement as to the loss payee's interest.
If we make any payments to the loss payee, we will obtain their rights against any other party.
